description: Representative four-channel frame: joint voltage and resource-constrained circuits with the same mechanical weights.
example_region: Middle right-beam patch (member 4, center 0.5, length fraction 0.18, modulus reduction 0.35)
coordinates: healthy_basis is the commissioned effective basis; regional_increments are the nominal forward increments used in the design. They are added in effective design coordinates without another gauge-factor multiplication.

scaled.weight_definition: weight_effective_strain = arm_sign * attenuation; weight_physical_strain includes the gauge-factor ratio. Linear voltage coefficients refer to zero strain and include supply drop and receiver loading.
scaled.component_convention: Bypassed gauges have no cell or shunt; null shunt on an active gauge means bare gauge. Ballast includes all series compensation; nominal arm resistance includes arm wire. Netlist node names are local to each bridge except source rails H and L; output is A minus B.

geometry.routing: Shortest connected-member centerline paths with normal depth leads; instrument at joint zero.
